footer_text: Por más de 70 años, nuestra pasión y compromiso por el campo, nos ha permitido ser líderes en la industria de implementos, insumos y repuestos de maquinaria agrícola en Chile.
Acepto la política de uso de datos personales
notes: Angular SPA (Angular Material) on Firebase Hosting; data from api.agroplanet.cl/webapi (SAP Hybris behind a JSON facade; public GET; the cart is the JSESSIONID cookie, so fetch(url, {credentials: 'include'}) from the page shares the visitor's cart).

Every in-site navigation is client-side: category, product, search (/busqueda/<text>), listing state (?q=<hybris query>&page=<0-based>&sort=), /carro, /cotizacion. Only a reload or a typed URL loads the document. Menu entries are <a> without href (router clicks); product cards, breadcrumbs, sub-category links and footer links have real hrefs.

Category URL = /categoria/<any slug>/<code>: the router resolves by code, so the flyout's and the red bar's different slugs (lubricantes_y_fluidos vs lubricantes, both AG01) are the same page. Codes: level 1 AGnn, level 2 AGnnn, level 3 numeric.
The flyout names a category one way and its listing another ('Lubricantes Y Fluidos' is titled 'Lubricantes y Grasas' on its page): categories.json keeps both, name and page_name.

Listing filters are mat-expansion panels titled as the API names them ('Precio', 'Marca', 'Viscosidad', 'Cca (-18 Grados)'…); only 'Precio' is open by default; option labels are the API's names without counts. A category page shows its sub-categories as links, not as a 'Categoría' filter (search results do show 'Categoría'). Sort: 'Relevancia', 'Menor precio', 'Mayor precio'. No result count is printed on the page.

No checkout and no online payment: the cart's only action is 'Cotizar' → /cotizacion, the 'Formulario de cotización', ending in 'Crear cotización' (needs RUT). Payment for a quote is off-site, through the Webpay link in the top bar and footer.
Some products show 'Confirmar precio en tienda' instead of a price (hidePriceByCategory). Every product page says the price may change with another pickup store or delivery mode.
A full load of / opens an empty dialog (app-generic-dialog) that blocks scrolling until closed. Cookie bar 'Entendido' at the bottom. After scrollY ≈150 a 64 px sticky header appears.
The home's titled blocks are 'Aprovecha estas oportunidades en <Mes>' (changes monthly) and 'CATEGORÍAS'; the other blocks are image banners and carousels with no text heading.
Much of the policy text is shared with the sister site Autoplanet and names Autoplanet / autoplanet.cl; pages.json marks those pages autoplanet_text.
ayuda.agroplanet.cl (help centre, T&C) opens in a new tab and did not answer from India; its 2023 copies on the Wayback Machine are the source of the 'terminos' topic.
